text:
maria: Heads up — getting a pile of 401s since ~09:12 UTC. Multiple customers (acme-inc, brightside) reporting API calls failing right after last night’s auth key rotation. Support queue + PagerDuty lighting up. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: auth/key-rotation/2026-03-14T09:10:42Z -> rolled to prod :white_check_mark:

eli (oncall): copying a few of the error traces here — are these 401 or 500s? Any reproducible request?

maria: Mostly 401 with this header and body from customer curl:

```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_token\", error_description=\"kid not found\"
{"error":"invalid_token","message":"signature verification failed"}
```

maria: Also seeing spikes in our auth-service logs: lots of `kid` lookup misses and HK error counts.

clara: pulling logs — auth-service shows repeated failures resolving new key id. Snippet:

```
[09:11:57] auth-service ERROR validate_token: kid=2026-03-14-rot-2 not found in jwks cache
[09:11:58] auth-service WARN jwks-sync: fetch failed, status=502
[09:12:03] auth-service ERROR token_verify: signature mismatch for kid=2026-03-14-rot-2
```

eng-runtime: Looks like JWKS propagation failed. Our rotation pushed a new JWK set to KMS+control plane but edge caches didn't pick it up. Possible sync job failure.

sanjay: Confirmed — the nightly sync job exit code=1 at 09:08. Redis propagation latencies jumped. Output from sync agent:

```
$ /usr/local/bin/jwks-sync --to=edge --version=2026-03-14-rot-2
Error: failed to POST https://edge-cdn.internal/jwks: dial tcp 10.2.3.4:443: connect: connection timed out
Exit code: 1
```

support-bot: 6 high-priority tickets opened in last 12m, customers affected: acme-inc, brightside, commercehq. Some mention retried POSTs succeed after ~15s then fail again.

eli (oncall): Action plan: 1) roll back rotation to previous JWK set (hotfix), 2) re-run jwks-sync with backoff and circuit-breaker enabled, 3) open temporary fallback in verifier to accept previous kid for 10m. I'll coordinate rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: auth/key-rotation -> reverting to rotation-2026-02-25 (user-initiated) :arrow_backward:

eng-runtime: Pushing runtime config change to allow `kid` fallback (10m) while we heal propagation. Patch applied to canary 09:18, rolling to remaining nodes.

clara: After rollback + fallback: error rates dropped to baseline within ~3m. Metrics: 401 count on /v1/generate fell from 420/min to 12/min.

ops-monitor: Alert cleared for auth-401-spike at 09:22 UTC.

maria: Support update to customers: temporary rollback done, please retry. Apologized and opened tickets for postmortem.

eli (oncall): Root cause (prelim): sync job doesn't handle transient connection failures to edge CDN during rotation. When job fails, control plane marked rotation complete and deactivated previous keys, leaving in-flight tokens unverifiable. Two contributing factors: 1) rotation flow marks new key active before successful edge propagation, 2) no verifier fallback for recently-rotated kid.

clara: short repro steps (internal):
1) Push new JWK set `kid=a` via control-plane API
2) Simulate edge CDN outage (iptables DROP to 10.2.3.4:443)
3) Observe auth-service attempts -> `kid` not found / jwks-sync exit 1
4) Invalidate old JWK locally -> clients with tokens signed by old key 401

```
# quick repro curl
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# expect 401 with \"kid not found\"
```

sanjay: Root cause of sync failure: recent CDN health change rolled out last week tightened ephemeral port reuse and our sync job didn't respect new SNI settings. Job was hitting 502 on TLS handshake intermittently. Patch underway.

eli (oncall): Immediate mitigations completed: rollback, verifier fallback, re-run sync with retry+SNI flag. Next: schedule controlled canary for rotations with health-gate (must confirm edge JWKS reachable from 5 regions before deactivating old key).

clara: Postmortem owner: clara. Will include timeline, deployment process checklist, test harness for jwks propagation, and monitoring to detect `kid` lookup failures earlier. Proposed action items:
- add propagation gating to rotation pipeline (block completion until jwks-sync success across N regions)
- make verifier accept previous kid for configured grace window by default
- harden jwks-sync with SNI + retry + circuit-breaker
- add metric `jwks.sync.failure_rate` and alert at 1% of rotations

maria: Thanks everyone — I’ll keep customer comms updated and escalate any premium customers who ask for credits.

eli (oncall): Logging this as INCIDENT-2026-03-14-AUTH-JWKS. Moving to postmortem phase. If anyone has more traces or flaky CDN endpoints to call out, drop here. :thumbsup:
